prompts.proposer:

The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='CWT_catboost', recommended_method='best_per_horizon_by_validation'. Narrative: CWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (7.956), making it the overall and trend champion. CWT_catboost leads in seasonality capture (0.4699 correlation). The extreme RMSE spread (179.55) and different horizon specialists (rf early, CWT_rf late) indicate per-horizon selection is valuable. High disagreement and concept drift suggest dynamic weighting over static combinations.
